posts.title: 2D GAA CFETs Need Contact And Parasitic Co-Optimization At A2 Node (imec)
posts.summary:
Researchers from imec published a technical paper titled “Are Gate-All-Around 2D CFETs the Optimal Architecture for the A2 Node and Beyond?” Abstract Excerpt: “Here, we develop an A2-oriented 2D CFET integration flow with a CPP of 36 nm and Lg of 10 nm and present initial demonstrations of several key process modules. Despite their atomically... » read more
The post 2D GAA CFETs Need Contact And Parasitic Co-Optimization At A2 Node (imec) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Imec research indicates that 2D gate-all-around (GAA) CFETs do not provide a contacted poly pitch (CPP) scaling advantage over silicon GAA CFETs at the A2 node.
The study establishes a minimum CPP of 36 nm for 2D CFETs, constrained by current contact formation limitations despite the use of atomically thin channels.
The researchers emphasize that achieving the potential of the A2 node requires rigorous co-optimization of parasitic extraction and contact integration alongside circuit-level benchmarking.
The findings suggest that while 2D materials are promising, architectural gains are currently bottlenecked by physical integration constraints rather than channel material properties alone.

posts.title: Standards-Compliant 112G PHY for Linear Optics: Driving Efficient AI Infrastructure
posts.summary:
112G PHY IP for linear optics to reduce power, latency and thermal load for high-speed data movement in AI and data center systems.
The post Standards-Compliant 112G PHY for Linear Optics: Driving Efficient AI Infrastructure appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Synopsys has introduced a 112G PHY IP compliant with the OIF-CEI-112G-LINEAR-PAM4 standard, designed to enable DSP-less host-to-module connectivity.
Transitioning to linear optics can reduce module power consumption by up to 50% by eliminating the need for power-hungry DSPs and retimers.
The reduction in power and thermal load is critical for high-density AI racks, where heat dissipation remains a primary constraint for scaling interconnects beyond 800G.
This technology provides a scalable path toward 224G/448G speeds and co-packaged optics (CPO), facilitating more efficient data movement in large-scale AI infrastructure.

posts.title: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
posts.summary: Business and technology leaders need no convincing that the time of agentic AI is here. Organizations are rapidly adopting agents, and few executives doubt the technology’s potential to transform work. But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data…
bullets: A survey of 300 executives reveals that legacy data infrastructure is the primary bottleneck preventing organizations from achieving ROI on agentic AI deployments.
Current enterprise AI agents have access to only 45% of company data on average, with 'data laggards' restricted to 30% or less, severely limiting autonomous decision-making capabilities.
Gartner predicts that AI agents will automate or augment 50% of business decisions by 2027, making the modernization of data access and integration a critical strategic priority.
Leading organizations that provide AI agents with access to over 70% of their enterprise data are reporting significantly higher success rates and greater trust in automated outcomes.

posts.title: Scientists just created female clones of male mice
posts.summary: Scientists have deliberately turned male mouse embryos into females for the first time. A team based in Japan used a CRISPR-based approach to remove the Y chromosome from male cells and create female clones of male mice.  “No one has done this before,” says Monika Ward, a reproductive biologist at the University of Hawaii, who…
bullets: Researchers in Japan have successfully used a CRISPR-based technique to remove the Y chromosome from male mouse embryos, effectively creating female clones from male cells.
While currently in the preprint stage on bioRxiv, this breakthrough challenges the biological requirement for both male and female gametes for reproduction.
The technology is being positioned as a potential tool for conservation biology, offering a pathway to rescue endangered species where only a limited number of individuals remain.
The method draws inspiration from natural sex-reversal mechanisms observed in species like the Okinawa rubble goby, suggesting broader applications for mammalian reproductive science.

posts.title: Xiaomi EV delivers 31,267 units in July, 39% of annual target
posts.summary:
Xiaomi EV needs average monthly deliveries of nearly 67,000 units over the remaining 5 months to achieve its full-year target of 550,000 units.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xiaomi EV delivered 31,267 vehicles in July, marking a fourth consecutive month above the 30,000-unit threshold but representing a 9.99% decline from June.
The company has achieved only 39% of its 550,000-unit annual delivery target, necessitating a significant ramp-up to an average of 67,000 units per month for the remainder of the year.
Xiaomi is pivoting toward the extended-range electric vehicle (EREV) segment with its new Sky Nomad series, positioning the N90 Max and N70 Max to compete directly with Li Auto and Aito.

While market reports suggest strong initial pre-order interest for the Sky Nomad line, the aggressive pricing strategy has introduced volatility to Xiaomi's stock, reflecting investor concerns over margins and competitive pressure.
